from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Photography only captures light intensity.", 
            "Holography records the wave phase.", 
            "It uses reference and object beams.", 
            "They interfere to create depth.", 
            "This reveals true three-dimensional images."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Holography: Encoding the Phase", lecture_lines)
        
        # Assets
        laser_icon = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/laser.svg")
        plate_icon = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plate.svg")
        hologram_icon = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/hologram.svg")

        # Prep elements
        ref_beam = Line(start=self.grid['A3'], end=self.grid['E3'], color="#FF0000")
        obj_beam = Line(start=self.grid['A4'], end=self.grid['E4'], color="#00FF00")
        light_beams = VGroup(laser_icon, ref_beam, obj_beam)
        
        plate = plate_icon.copy()
        interference_label = Text("Interference", font_size=20, color="#FFFFFF")
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFD700")
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#00FFFF")
        self.place_in_area(light_beams, 'A3', 'E4', scale_factor=0.7)
        self.play(FadeIn(light_beams))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FF69B4")
        self.place_at_grid(plate, 'B4', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.play(FadeIn(plate))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color("#7FFF00")
        self.place_at_grid(interference_label, 'C4', scale_factor=0.5)
        fringe = VGroup(*[Line(plate.get_left(), plate.get_right(), color="#FFFFFF", stroke_width=1) for _ in range(5)])
        fringe.arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1).move_to(plate)
        self.play(Create(fringe), Write(interference_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[4].set_color("#FFA500")
        hologram_icon.set_color("#FFFFFF")
        self.place_at_grid(hologram_icon, 'C4', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.play(
            FadeOut(light_beams), FadeOut(fringe), FadeOut(plate), FadeOut(interference_label),
            FadeIn(hologram_icon)
        )
        self.wait(2)

outline.topic: The Magic of Light: Principles of Diffraction and Holography

sections.title: Prerequisite: Wave Superposition
sections.content: Briefly introduce the principle of superposition: when two light waves meet, they create an interference pattern. Visual focus: overlapping ripples in a pond.
sections.example: Visualize two stones dropped into a pond simultaneously; the resulting complex pattern of crests and troughs is the foundation of holography.

sections.title: Diffraction: Light Bending Around Obstacles
sections.content: Define diffraction as the behavior of light waves bending around small apertures or edges. Introduce the concept of the 'diffraction pattern' as a fingerprint of an object.
sections.example: Shining a laser pointer through a tiny pinhole creates a central bright spot surrounded by concentric rings—the 'Airy disk'.

sections.title: Holography: Encoding the Phase
sections.content: Explain that photography only captures intensity (brightness), but holography captures phase (distance/depth) by using an interference pattern between a reference beam and a reflected object beam.
sections.example: A holographic 'security sticker' on a credit card: tilting it causes the light to diffract at different angles, revealing a 3D depth effect.

sections.title: Reconstruction: Decoding the 3D Image
sections.content: Describe how the interference pattern (hologram) acts like a complex diffraction grating. When coherent light hits it, it 'reconstructs' the original wave front.
sections.example: The 'Iron Man' holographic interface: a light source shines through the recorded diffraction pattern, projecting a 3D avatar of a character into mid-air.

sections.title: Summary and Real-world Application
sections.content: Synthesize the lesson: Holography is simply the recording of a diffraction pattern. Conclude with modern applications in medicine, data storage, and art.
sections.example: Mention holographic medical imaging, where doctors view a 3D scan of a heart floating in space, allowing for precise surgery planning.
